summary.interpretation: Operational LiDAR field aid. Protocol resolution is a confidence label, not a gate that hides measurements. READY_FOR_FIELD_USE preserves all 29 earlier full-resolution accepted measurements and adds clean new full-LAS geometry fits. CHECK_ON_SITE remains visible as a lower-confidence candidate. The 11 legacy adaptive measurements use irregular-zone-top +0.30 m; they are useful field aids but are not relabelled as confirmed highest-prop-root-attachment measurements. Human-confirmed wrong Tree IDs are retained only as excluded audit records and contribute no operational circumference or diameter.
